description: Collect Direct Debit payments with GoCardless: create customers and bank accounts, set up mandates, collect one-off payments, run subscriptions and instalment plans, and follow what happens to each payment.

gocardless_new_customer_trigger.description: Runs for each new customer in your GoCardless account, with their name, email and address. Customers already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.metadata: Your notes kept on the customer.

gocardless_new_event_trigger.description: Runs for each new thing that happens in your GoCardless account, such as a payment being confirmed or failing, or a mandate becoming active. Choose a kind of record and an event to run for just one, or leave both empty to run for every event. Events already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.action: What happened, such as confirmed, failed or cancelled.
output.details: The cause, a plain-words description and where it came from.
output.links: The IDs of the records it concerns, such as the payment or mandate.
output.resource_type: The kind of record: payments, mandates, subscriptions and so on.

parameters.description: Only run for events about this kind of record: payments, mandates, subscriptions, payouts, refunds, instalment_schedules, billing_requests or creditors. Leave empty for any.
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.description: Only run for this event, such as confirmed, failed, paid_out, cancelled or active. Leave empty for any.
parameters.name: event_action

gocardless_new_mandate_trigger.description: Runs for each new mandate in your GoCardless account, with its scheme, status and the customer and bank account it belongs to. Mandates already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.links: The IDs of its customer, bank account and creditor.
output.reference: The reference on the customer's statement.
output.scheme: The Direct Debit scheme, such as bacs.

gocardless_new_payment_trigger.description: Runs for each new payment in your GoCardless account, including those a subscription creates, with its amount (in pence or cents), charge date and status. Payments already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.amount: The amount in pence or cents.
output.links: The IDs of its mandate, creditor and subscription.
